RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This ID is generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

SecurityScore.description_en:
The security score of the assets. The following list describes the mapping between score ranges and asset security statuses:

95 to 100: Your assets are in good security condition.
85 to 94: Your assets have security risks. Reinforce the security protection system as soon as possible.
70 to 84: Your assets have multiple security risks. Reinforce the security protection system promptly.
Below 69: Your assets have weak defenses against cyberattacks. Reinforce the security protection system as soon as possible
SecurityScore.description_zh:
资产的安全分值。以下是分值区间和资产安全状态的对应关系：

95~100：表示您的资产安全状态良好。
85~94：表示您的资产存在安全隐患，建议尽快加固安全防护体系。
70~84：表示您的资产存在较多安全隐患，建议及时加固安全防护体系。
69分以下：表示您的资产防御黑客入侵的能力很弱，需要尽快加固安全防护体系
